meta.source: NASA FIRMS: VIIRS (Suomi NPP) 375 m and MODIS (Terra, Aqua) 1 km active fire detections, country yearly archive
meta.citation: NASA FIRMS, https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/ (MODIS Collection 6.1 and VIIRS S-NPP 375 m standard-quality archive)
meta.rule: a detection within 1,000 m of the recorded position; low confidence left out; presumed vegetation or land fires only
meta.time: days are in Myanmar time (UTC+6:30); each detection lists [local day, local time, sensor V or M, metres from the village, confidence, fire radiative power MW, D day or N night pass, UTC date, UTC time]
meta.caution: A detection is heat seen from orbit: it does not say what burned or who lit it. Fires under cloud are not detected, so no detection does not mean no fire.
